> [This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.](embed:example.com-1)

The webpage at [Example Domain](embed:example.com-1) serves as a placeholder website managed by IANA (Internet Assigned Numbers Authority). It is reserved specifically for use in illustrative examples in documentation and instructional manuals, meaning it should not be used for live websites or operational systems. 

You can learn more about its purpose on the [IANA Domains page](https://iana.org/domains/example).
